leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the createContext function to construct a new React context for cart state management.
Define a CartProvider component that wraps children and provides access to cart state and functions.
Implement a useCart custom hook to access the cart context within functional components.
Utilize the useState hook to initialize and manage cart items state within the context provider.
Construct functions to handle adding items to the cart, updating quantity based on existing items.
Execute functions to remove items from the cart by filtering the state array.
Control cart item quantity by implementing increment and decrement operations.
Use the useContext hook within components to retrieve cart state and handler functions.
Access cart state properties (items, total items, total price) from the context in UI components.
Invoke cart context functions from event handlers to update cart state based on user interactions.
Return structured JSX that displays cart items by iterating through the cart state array.
Modify component state through context functions to reflect cart changes across the application.
